title: Concept: CakePHP DebugKit toolbar in a response
description: A CakePHP DebugKit toolbar in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: DebugKit exposes the SQL log, the request variables and the session of every page it instruments, which together describe the application and its data.
applicability: Deployments that render a CakePHP DebugKit toolbar into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: DebugKit exposes the SQL log, the request variables and the session of every page it instruments, which together describe the application and its data.
